content.short: TONCO is the first concentrated liquidity DEX on TON, allowing for maximized capital efficiency for providers.
content.description: TONCO is a pioneering decentralized exchange on the TON blockchain that introduces concentrated liquidity to the ecosystem. Unlike traditional AMMs, TONCO allows liquidity providers to specify price ranges for their capital, significantly increasing capital efficiency and reducing slippage for traders. This advanced model attracts deeper liquidity and provides a more sophisticated trading environment for all users. By bringing this high-efficiency DEX model to TON, TONCO is pushing the boundaries of what is possible in decentralized finance on the network.
